newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate ends higher on NCD issue.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate ends higher on NCD issue.

text.p: Taiwan's interbank rate closed slightly higher on Thursday following the government's issue of T$5 billion in Negotiable Certificates of Deposit to mop up excess liquidity, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate ended at 5.129 percent against Wednesday's 5.120 close, though 30-day commercial paper ended unchanged at 5.15 percent. Dealers expected rates to hover around the current levels on Friday.
The bond market saw no transaction in the afternoon. The 10-year 83/1 bond yield was at 6.0025 after morning trade.
